message.content:
**Analysis:**

The function writes three bytes into `s->buf` (108 bytes) on every call without ever checking `s->used` against `SLCBUF_SIZE`. Since the caller invokes this once per SLC option received from the remote peer, an attacker-controlled number of calls (e.g., more than 36 triplets) drives `s->used` past the end of the buffer, causing a heap/stack overflow. The missing bounds check manifests at the first unchecked write.

Answer: 18
